The fix is to ensure that we only proceed if there is actual login or password information present in the returned tuple.

I have modified `src/requests/utils.py` to check for non-empty login or password fields before returning the netrc authentication tuple.

```python
            _netrc = netrc(netrc_path).authenticators(host)
            if _netrc and _netrc[0] or _netrc[1]:
                # Return with login / password
                login_i = 0 if _netrc[0] else 1
                return (_netrc[login_i], _netrc[2])
```
